title: Netflix’s new AI Discover tab helps you find something to watch based on your mood
slides: Netflix bets your mood beats your watch history
A new AI Discover tab reads how you feel
But mood shifts faster than any algorithm tracks
Expect sharper picks, fewer endless scroll nights
Test it tonight: pick a mood, judge the result
thread_text:
1. Netflix's Mood Play

Netflix is testing an AI tab that recommends shows based on how you feel, not what you've watched.

2. Feelings Over History

The new Discover tab asks you to pick a mood, then serves up content it thinks fits that emotion.

3. Moods Move Fast

Your mood can change in minutes, but the algorithm's picks lag behind, possibly missing the mark.

4. Sharper Picks or Missed Shots

If it works, you'll spend less time scrolling. If not, you'll get suggestions that feel off.

5. Try It Yourself

Tonight, open Netflix, choose a mood, and see if the first recommendation actually matches how you feel.

instagram.caption:
Netflix is testing a tab that asks how you feel before it shows you what to watch.

It's called Discover, and it builds recommendations from your mood instead of your watch history. 🎬

The catch: your mood can shift in minutes, while the algorithm's picks lag behind. 🤔

If it works, you spend less time scrolling and more time watching. If it doesn't, you get suggestions that feel off.

Worth testing yourself: pick a mood tonight and see if the first pick actually fits. What mood would you choose first? 😅
